# Pine

Biome: Black Forest | Wood Type: Corewood, and, Wood | Yield: 30 | Tool Needed: Stone axe | Additional Loot: Pine cone, ,, Feathers, ,, Resin

# Introduction

Pine is a type of tree that can be found in the Black Forest biome. It is characterized by its tall, skinny trunk. A Stone axe or better is required to damage it.
Pine trees produce Wood and Corewood when destroyed. The yield of each type of wood appears to be random, however, a pine tree will always drop 30 pieces of wood total.
Pine cones can be planted with a cultivator to grow more Pine. Pine trees can be planted in the Meadows. The low drop rate on the Pine Cones makes Pine, and thus Corewood, unsustainable.

• Item: Wood | Amount: 0-30 | Chance: From logs | Average: 15

• Item: Corewood | Amount: 0-30 | Chance: From logs | Average: 15

• Item: Wood | Amount: 2 | Chance: From stump | Average: 2
